hypothesis: Request216 failed because current-state features do not encode the recent path shape well enough. Causal recent-path features plus a within-day rank-oriented learning objective can recover transferable ordering of next-executable-event HOLD value.
frozen: no absolute HOLD threshold or recurrent policy replay in this experiment

candidate_representation.causality: Only current and prior observed POSITION states are allowed. No next-event timestamp, next-event price, future gap, best future price or future horizon enters the feature set.

rank_target: Within each training trading day, percentile rank of realized next-executable-event BASE HOLD advantage. The target changes the learning emphasis from exact return magnitude to relative ordering.
comparators: Request216 expected-value score using current-state/event-time features
same rank objective with current-state/event-time features only
good_day_definition: Daily Spearman > 0 and the top 10% of candidate scores have positive mean realized HOLD advantage.
forbidden: using fresh outcomes to choose path windows or sources
using future observation timing as a feature
claiming a profitable trading policy from a ranking-only result
next_if_pass: Use fit/calibration history only to map ranking into an absolute HOLD/EXIT value gate, then run a recurrent event-time trajectory experiment.
next_if_fail: Stop hand-crafted path expansion and test a learned sequence representation over chronological observed-state histories.
